ValidationRule.description: On RCA onboardings, the Primary Root Cause (Section 3), at least one Specific Reason Code (Section 4), and a Remediation Action (Section 6) must be completed before the Stage can advance past Investigation. (INC3-35)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "RCA", NOT(ISPICKVAL(Stage__c, "Investigation")), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Primary_Root_Cause__c)), ISBLANK(Specific_Reason_Codes__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Remediation_Action__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Before advancing an RCA past Investigation, complete the Primary Root Cause (Section 3), at least one Specific Reason Code (Section 4), and a Remediation Action (Section 6).
